verdict.rationale: Recruitee's support docs say recruiters can create and manage application forms. Its API docs confirm jobs carry questions that candidates answer and that apply fields such as name, phone, email and CV are required by default. That evidences custom questions only thinly, and nothing covers knockout or disqualification rules or compliant EEOC/demographic collection. Missing for 10: documented custom question types and editor, knockout/auto-disqualify rules, EEOC/demographic collection with compliance handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly

citations.quote: Create and manage your job openings, hiring pipelines, and application forms
API also allows answering the job’s questions. You just need to attach a list of answers to the request.
By default, these fields are required: name, phone, email, cv.
